cases.summary: Search account, hashtag, and summary painters. Inputs are the offline capture in api/bin/search-render-reference-capture.php (hashtag, account, and summary kinds).
Search text and tag query normalization from api/bin/search-query-reference.php.

Library card pieces from api/bin/migration-library-component-capture.php: reply CW, content warnings, relative time, media, account refs, reply meta, asks, link previews, quotes, RSS titles/summaries/statuses, Unicode width, URL aliases, emoji, reply handles, and compact counts.
Remote actor labels, flat cache keys, warm predicates, and local avatar sanitizing from api/bin/profile-identity-components-reference.php.
Profile markdown and profile-field HTML from api/bin/profile-secondary-components-reference.php.

Settings profile field contract. PHP list is vaak_settings_parity_canonical_fields(); the declared fixture is api/fixtures/settings/profile-fields.json. Rust compares CANONICAL_FIELDS and rust/vaak-worker/fixtures/settings/profile-fields.json.

Public discovery (ap_visibility_public_status vs Rust Local/Profile/Federated) and durable recheck (ap_visibility_status_audience_allowed on in-memory SQLite vs Rust Home/Library/Search/Direct). Fixture: parity/fixtures/audience.json. Rust records are the durable map; they are not a second SQL engine.
OpenSim player normalization. Shared fixture rust/vaak-worker/fixtures/phyrian/opensim-normalization.json, replayed through both producers rather than compared only to expected.json.
OpenSim bridge envelope and response decoder, including the numeric ok:1 case. Fixture: parity/fixtures/phyrian-bridge.json.

Follow Accept/Reject state, delivery-log redaction, and quiet-host fallback selection. PHP ap_follow_state.php is the live decision code. Rust follow_fallback replays the same inputs and does not fetch or open a database.

Local profile header, tabs, relationship row, and empty Pins or Asks bodies. PHP capture is api/bin/profile-local-chrome-capture.php. Rust profile_local paints the same chrome and does not open a database.
Remote ActivityPub profile header, relationship row, and tabs. PHP capture is api/bin/profile-remote-chrome-capture.php. Rust profile_remote paints the same chrome and does not open a database.

Home, Local, and Federated older-page cursors. Compares created_at + source + id boundaries, same-timestamp id ties, and filtered windows that must not be treated as the end of stored posts. No database.
Bluesky profile header, relationship row, and tabs. PHP capture is api/bin/profile-bsky-chrome-capture.php. Rust profile_bsky_chrome paints the same chrome and does not open a database.

Guest profile follow panel and action row, cold avatar facts, and the local pagination shell. PHP capture is api/bin/profile-guest-actions-capture.php. Rust paints the same chrome and does not open a database or warm media.

Wafrn ActivityPub/Bluesky post identity, alsoKnownAs DID extraction, text ask cards, linkage dedupe, and the 10 minute text fallback. Fixture api/fixtures/wafrn-crosspost.json. Both sides call the pure planner and do not open a database.

Pleroma-safe public Note, actor, and featured documents. url is a single http(s) string, at:// stays on blueskyUri, alsoKnownAs is left alone, and empty media text becomes a zero-width space. No database.
